source: Video scheduled-news day filter; RULE-004/STR-012/RES-001/RES-006/RES-011 and new DATA-011 inventory. Official sources: https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2022/01_sched.htm and https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm
calendar: Immutable content-bound versions include explicit coverage, selected kinds, completeness attestation, origin, source URLs/body hashes/retrieval times, events and knowledge policy. CPI/jobs/scheduled Fed decisions are the free preset, not every possible market-moving event. Custom CSV/JSON imports are supported. No arbitrary URL is fetched.
knowledge: Official current/archived web-page acquisition is a retrospective schedule reconstruction; dates are assumed known in advance and prominently labeled conditional. Do not fabricate historical publication timestamps. As-of imports require explicit timezone-aware known_at per event; apply only at signal/candidate confirmation time >= known_at on that New York event date. Synthetic fixtures remain labeled. Revisions create new versions; old jobs never silently acquire a changed schedule.
integration: Public new experiments/searches/portfolios/controls/ablations/studies freeze a selected version and its exact snapshot/hash. Non-trade news rules require a calendar. Raw news_dates requests are rejected; legacy internal authored fixtures retain explicit set semantics. Coverage, snapshot/source integrity and complete declaration validate before price reads, including worker recovery. Final study calendars freeze before screening/final use. Passive benchmarks and behavior studies do not apply this strategy filter.
matching: Random controls exclude known news moments under skip and additionally match the half-risk news weight under half, retaining source denominators and independent account execution. Paired arms share the same calendar; absolute profits and comparative differences remain separate.
acquisition: Allowlisted BLS monthly calendar and Fed meeting-calendar URLs only, bounded HTML and date spans, strict parser/coverage checks, no redirects or credential headers, bounded retry/cancellation. Persist content-addressed raw public sources and content-bound per-job completed-document checkpoints; orphan/partial/corrupt downloads cannot publish a complete calendar. A new download is a fresh observation; resume may reuse only verified documents from that job.
verification: Author independent January2022 dates/jobs Jan7, CPI Jan12, Fed Jan26; Fed full2022 decisions Jan26/Mar16/May4/Jun15/Jul27/Sep21/Nov2/Dec14. Test cross-month meetings, overflow cells, missing/changed schemas, cancellation/retry/cache faults, immutable identity, malformed imports, causal known-at boundaries/DST, no-price-read guards, all job kinds including controls/paired/study/final, metadata/export parity and real two-desktop import/acquisition/run/report flows. Keep first failures and scoped receipts; no final certification inferred.
